about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for scripts/htc-night2.sh, over a fake repo/runs-root (HTC_REPO/HTC_RUNS_ROOT) with a stub .venv/bin/python and a stubbed-out pgrep -- never the real main checkout, never darktable, never the real corpus.
subject: scripts/htc-night2.sh

examples.why: a first start (no CURRENT_STAMP, no pidfile) mints a night2-YYYYMMDD stamp and gets all the way to the (stubbed) generate step -- exit 2 is that stub's failure, not a precondition refusal
a live night-2 runner.pid must block a second start before darktable could ever be launched twice
night-2 must not start while night-1's runner is still up, even though they use separate stamps and pidfiles -- only one darktable-driving runner may run at a time
